Garcia, Jr. |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Nationalist People's Coalition}}|border=darkgray}} [[Nationalist People's Coalition|NPC]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Rizal's 3rd congressional district''' is one of the four [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Rizal (province)|Rizal]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2022.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} The district consists of the north-western municipality of [[San Mateo, Rizal|San Mateo]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by Jose Arturo "Jojo" S. Garcia, Jr. of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]], who is its first representative since its creation.{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=January 23, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class="wikitable" ! rowspan="2" |# ! rowspan=2 colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" |Member ! colspan="2" |Tenure ! rowspan="2" |Congress ! rowspan="2" |Party ! rowspan="2" |Electoral history ! rowspan="2" |Constituent [[Local government in the Philippines|LGUs]] |- !Start !End |- | colspan="10" style="text-align:center;" | ===Rizal's 3rd district for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]=== |- | colspan="10" style="text-align:center;" |District created April 12, 2021 from [[Rizal's 2nd congressional district|Rizal's 2nd district]].{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=11546 |date=March 30, 2021 |title=An Act Reapportioning the Second Legislative District of the Province of Rizal into Three (3) Legislative Districts |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2021/03/25/republic-act-no-11533/ |access-date=August 8, 2022}} |- | rowspan="2" | '''1''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|Nationalist People's Coalition}};" rowspan="2" | | rowspan="2" | [[File:Rep.
